name: Datong memorial exhibition hall reconstruction
scope: Best-effort exhibition-hall reconstruction at the published Datong memorial exhibition POI. Original nearest9x19.55m numerical roof outline retained. Association to the exhibition POI4.58m outside its south edge is probable and explicitly unverified; height, flat roof, doors, windows and exact era are original estimates. This is the bounded building visualization, not a measured model of the337000m²memorial grounds, underground galleries or3500m²aggregate exhibit area.
